svg.title: Homelab network diagnosis stack
svg.desc: Excalidraw diagnostic stack separating host capability, switch and VLAN configuration, DHCP and gateway, DNS, OPNsense policy, and public origin behavior.

g.text: “The Network Is Broken” Is Six Questions
fixing one layer does not prove the layers above it
can the LXC or VM create the interface?
is the correct tag carried on the correct port?
did the workload receive the intended reservation?
does the expected name resolve from this zone?
does first-match rule order permit this exact flow?
does the proxy and browser-visible HTTPS path work?
A green check at layer 3 is evidence about layer 3 —
not proof that the origin is reachable.
